snippet.title: ANTONBLAST – Launch Trailer – Nintendo Switch
snippet.description:
ANTONBLAST has finally crash landed onto Nintendo Switch: https://ninten.do/6058oPlNM 
 
It's Happy Hour! Demolish massive worlds with your Mighty Hammer and steal your Spirits back from the Devil himself! Your mission in every level is simple: SET Brulo's Detonators, FIND Anton's Spirit, and ESCAPE before Happy Hour ends! 
 
#ANTONBLAST #NintendoSwitch
